program.help:
Store a marked unit's waveform as a LINKED template series, written one .wtf file per method (variant) and stage (tag) next to the session — the template library. A template is not one global median but a linked series of per-bin medians, like a fiber's per-chunk geometry: * link=drift — a median per time chunk (tracks probe/tissue drift); * link=adapt — a median per spike-energy bin (tracks within-burst adaptation). Both are built in every requested spk variant and row-aligned to a shared .wtfinfo index.
Reads the clustering files ON DISK (save first if you have unsaved edits). nsamp and nchan are prefilled from the open group; variants is the list of .spk methods to template; clu-variant / clu-tag identify the units .clu to read. Engine: the fiber-kit 'fiber-template' console script.
